paragraphs: R. Yaakov of Kefar Ḥananyah, Rabbi's colleague (Yuḥasin, in the order of transmission that Rema copied from Yesod Olam). Their burial places are in Kefar Anan (see R. Ḥalafta of Kefar Ḥananyah).
